card.name: Interaction text before inducer or MAOI drugs
card.fires_on: The word 'avenous' in 'intravenous' before methylene blue, and linking words or commas just before a listed enzyme inducer such as rifampin, carbamazepine or phenobarbital in drug-interaction passages.

modes.label: Intravenous methylene blue
modes.description: The end of 'intravenous' when it comes right before methylene blue in MAOI warnings.
modes.example: a patient who is being treated with MAOIs such as linezolid or intr<<avenous>> methylene blue.

modes.label: Before inducer drug names
modes.description: A linking word or comma that comes right before an enzyme-inducer drug in an interaction list.
modes.example: Co-administration of micafungin for injection<< with>> rifampin and ritonavir

card.plain: It marks spots in drug-interaction text where a specific interacting drug name is about to come next.
